question: In a school, the number of students in class 4th, 5th and 6th were 188, 282 and 423 respectively. If each class is divided into sections and each section had the same number of students, then what was the minimum total number of sections in these three classes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To minimize the total sections, the number of students per section must be maximum.

Maximum students per section = HCF of (188, 282, 423) = 47.

Total sections = (188 ÷ 47) + (282 ÷ 47) + (423 ÷ 47)

Total sections = 4 + 6 + 9 = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 sections.**
